actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: _Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:_ +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. _Hit:_ 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
 **At Will:** _Detect Magic_, _Light_, _Mage Armor_ (included in AC), _Mage Hand_, _Prestidigitation_
 **2/Day Each:** _Fireball_ (level 4 version), _Invisibility_
 **1/Day Each:** _Cone of Cold_, _Fly_

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
bonusActions.text: The mage casts _Misty Step_, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.text: The mage casts _Counterspell_ or _Shield_ in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
